# Real-model fixtures

Unlike `tests/fixtures/*.onnx` (tiny synthetic graphs generated by
`tests/generate_fixtures.rs` that are *structurally representative* of
MobileNetV2/BERT-tiny but contain no real trained weights), this directory
holds a genuine, real-world-exported `.onnx` file used to smoke-test
compatibility against an actual ONNX export rather than a hand-built one.

The model itself is **not committed to git** (see `.gitignore`'s `*.onnx`
rule) — it's downloaded on demand by
`crates/tpt-infer-onnx/tests/real_model_fixtures.rs` and cached locally.
This keeps the repository small and the default `cargo test` run fully
offline/hermetic; only a CI job that explicitly opts in
(`TPT_INFER_FETCH_FIXTURES=1`) exercises this test.

## Fixture: MNIST (opset 12)

| | |
|---|---|
| File | `mnist-12.onnx` |
| Source | [`onnx/models`](https://github.com/onnx/models), a repository maintained by the ONNX project |
| URL | `https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/onnx/models/main/validated/vision/classification/mnist/model/mnist-12.onnx` |
| License | Apache License 2.0 (see [`onnx/models` LICENSE](https://github.com/onnx/models/blob/main/LICENSE)) |
| Size | ~26 KB |
| SHA-256 | `5c688690f8bacf667d4c2074af5ad0646ca328d7ab03eccf944a65b320171bdd` |

Verified structure (via `tpt_infer_onnx::load`): 21 nodes, 6 initializers,
input `Input3` of shape `[1, 1, 28, 28]`, output `Plus214` of shape
`[1, 10]`, and a Conv2d → Add → Relu → MaxPool2d (×2) → Reshape → MatMul →
Add pipeline — a real CNN export exercising operators this parser must
support, unlike the synthetic fixtures which are constructed directly
against `tpt_infer_graph::Operator` and can't catch real-export quirks
(e.g. `Reshape`'s shape coming from a second *input* tensor rather than an
attribute).

If this fixture ever needs replacing (e.g. the URL moves), pick a
similarly small, unambiguously-licensed model, update the constants in
`real_model_fixtures.rs`, and update this table.
